name: RLHF
definition: Aligns a model to preferences supplied by humans, with any optimiser.

name: Constitutional AI (CAI)
definition: Trains with AI feedback judged against a written constitution.

name: Machine unlearning
definition: Removes targeted knowledge or capabilities from a trained model.

name: Guard models
definition: Scores "unsafe" content with a dedicated safety LLM.

name: Chain-of-thought monitoring
definition: Reads a model's reasoning trace to flag unsafe intent.

name: Dangerous-capability evaluation
definition: Measures capabilities that could enable severe harm.

name: CBRN / high-risk-domain evaluation
definition: Evaluates chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear uplift.

name: Keyword / blocklist filter
definition: Blocks inputs or outputs that contain listed terms.

name: Differentially private training
definition: Trains under a stated differential-privacy guarantee.

name: Activation-space anomaly detection (MAD / OOD)
definition: Flags inputs whose activations are out of distribution.
